entities.summary: "Cirice" is a song by the Swedish rock band Ghost, released on May 30, 2015, as the lead single from their third studio album Meliora. The song peaked at number 4 on the Mainstream Rock Songs chart, and won the Grammy Award for Best Metal Performance in 2016.
